bdf_files.description: List of BDF font files to use (joined with '+' in invocation). Order matters: first fonts take precedence for overlapping glyphs.

equivalence_files.description: List of equivalence files (joined with '+' in invocation). Defines glyph equivalences to reduce PSF size.

symbol_sets.description: List of character set files to include; order matters: first sets take precedence if space is insufficient. Each item is a map with 'name' and optional 'warn' flag (bool, default true). A colon prefix suppresses warnings if warn=false. See manpage 'CHARACTER SETS'.

font_size.description: Number of glyphs in the output PSF font. Must be 256 or 512.

output_psf.description: Filename of the generated PSF font file. Will be overwritten if it exists.

sfm_file.description: Optional filename for the generated SFM file. If empty, SFM output is suppressed.

framebuffer.description: If true, pass --fb to generate font for framebuffer mode (handles glyph width and column copying differently).

log_file.description: If non-empty, pass --log <log_file> to record conversion issues to this file.
